templates.name: Fluxtion embedded
templates.description: The graph inline in your app — flow.onEvent(...), no server. Interpreted + keyless; the fastest way to feel the model in the Playground.

templates.name: Fluxtion connector
templates.description: DataFlowConnector host — in-memory/file feed → graph → sink. Keyless, runs in the Playground.

templates.name: Fluxtion DAG multi IO
templates.description: An AOT multi-IO DAG: 2 feeds into a root node, a Risk node joining two parents, and 2 sinks (alerts console + audit file) via per-trigger outputs. Runs in the Playground; a download needs a key once at build.

templates.name: Fluxtion AOT (native-ready)
templates.description: Build-time generated dispatcher (no runtime compiler). The GraalVM native-image target — mvn -Pnative package.

templates.name: Fluxtion auditors
templates.description: The Auditors section in action: event audit (log records to stdout), a user-metric MetricAuditor (totals on teardown), and record & replay (captures to replay/). Runs keyless in the Playground.

templates.name: Fluxtion service export
templates.description: A typed command surface (@ExportService): an OrderProcessorCommands interface the node implements, called via flow.getExportedService() — embedding without an event envelope. Runs keyless in the Playground.

templates.name: Fluxtion DataFlow DSL
templates.description: A DataFlow DSL pipeline: subscribe → map (extract the metric) → slidingAggregate (a rolling-average window) → map (your own classifier) → console — all method references, no imperative @OnEventHandler node. Runs keyless in the Playground.

templates.name: Fluxtion Spring XML
templates.description: A multi-node Fluxtion DAG wired in Spring XML (application-context.xml): price/order/news events fan into volatility + sentiment calcs, joined by a RiskEngine and an OrderGate. Open it in the IntelliJ Fluxtion visualiser. AOT; runs in the Playground.

templates.name: Mongoose server
templates.description: A runnable Mongoose server: file feed → processor → file sink, with the admin web console.

templates.name: Mongoose + Fluxtion
templates.description: A Fluxtion AOT graph hosted inside a Mongoose server (the same artefact, two runtimes).

templates.name: Fluxtion Spring in Mongoose
templates.description: The full stack: a Spring-XML-defined Fluxtion graph (open it in the IntelliJ visualiser), AOT-generated at build, hosted in a Mongoose server with performance monitoring (perfMon auditor + audit capture autostart) and the web admin console with source navigation.

templates.name: Mongoose dynamic feeds
templates.description: Add event feeds to a RUNNING server: svc-loader-feed + the web admin Loader tab. Ships loader/dynamic-feed.yml — load it one-shot (feedLoader.compile) or persist it to replay at every boot (feedLoader.persistAndCompile).

templates.name: Mongoose dynamic Spring processor
templates.description: Recompile a processor without a server restart: svc-loader-spring loads loader/loaded-graph.xml at boot; edit the XML and reload from the admin console (springLoader.reloadCompileProcessor). graphmlRoots wired so the console renders the loaded graph.

templates.name: Audit analyser bundle
templates.description: The M19 onboarding bundle: a Spring-defined Fluxtion graph hosted in Mongoose, with the generated processor committed so it builds and runs with NO API key — plus an analyser project profile, agent skills and CLAUDE.md, and one-command export/stop. The starting point for the analyser tutorial.
